result.summary: The environment is a wide residential or institutional street with faded crosswalk markings and significant pedestrian exposure due to the crossing distance. While sidewalks and stop-control are present, the lack of physical traffic calming and the width of the roadway create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground at the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is excessively wide without a median or refuge, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with row houses, featuring basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and a marked crosswalk. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the intersection lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and clear sightlines due to parked vehicles and corner vegetation.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck is parked very close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view of pedestrians for drivers turning or approaching.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the corner

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian countdown signals to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, but the infrastructure is aging with faded paint and cracked pavement. The wide street layout and parked cars near the corners may create visibility and speed issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street and far left corner

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and on the sidewalk present trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway and right-side sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking at the corners.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals, but it is in a state of significant disrepair. The lack of curb ramps and the presence of cracked, uneven pavement and debris create accessibility and safety challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uneven and Cracked Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is heavily cracked and uneven, presenting a significant trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk area near the corner

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corner, making the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is extremely worn and difficult for motorists to see.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Trash and miscellaneous items are obstructing the clear path of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area in front of the residential buildings

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to provide a smooth, hazard-free walking surface.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the intersection to ensure accessibility.
